Optional FOND outcome discriminator. For actions whose PDDL effects are encoded as a oneOf, the responding station selects which branch occurred by setting Outcome to the 0-based index of the chosen child (in declaration order). Omitting the field — or setting Outcome=0 — is equivalent to selecting the first/only branch and is the correct contract for non-FOND actions.
